title: Cute Confetti, small bag.
text: Cute Confetti, small bag.. The confetti was nice, but please be warned that this is one small bag of confetti. For some reason, I thought there would be more to it than the price. It was enough to scatter on about 4 round tables sparingly.

product_metadata.title: Beistle Baby Girl Confetti, multicolor (CN049)
features: This item is a great value!
description: Beistle CN049 Baby Girl Confetti. This package contains small pieces of confetti shaped as "Baby Girl", feet and hearts in multicolor. There is a half ounce of confetti in the package. Spread this pretty confetti on tables for baby showers!.
